summary: October PPI came in a tenth under the consensus on the headline (+0.3% m/m against +0.4%, 6.5% y/y against 6.6%, after +1.3% in September) and SPY went from +0.39% to +0.71% pre-market in three minutes (762.53 at 08:33, at Thursday's 763.04 high, after +2.9% on the week). The relief is priced before the open and the core is not soft (ex food, energy and trade +0.5% m/m, 4.9% y/y; goods +0.5%), so the print does not take the December hike off the table (CME: 87% for 25bp, 13% for 50bp before the release; 10Y 5.13%). Chips are split (NVDA +2.3% on day two after the resignation, AMD -2.7%, AVGO -2.3% on a downgrade), Microsoft's outage runs into a second day, oil is back above $88 WTI on Trump's 'we don't need a deal with Iran'. Open to close is a coin flip with a small lean up: no SPY trade.
reasons: 08:30 PPI (BLS release page, read 08:33): final demand +0.3% m/m (consensus +0.4%, September +1.3%), 6.5% y/y (consensus 6.6%, September 6.3%); less foods, energy and trade services +0.5% m/m and 4.9% y/y; goods +0.5%, services +0.2%. Headline a tenth cool, core firm. The standard core (ex food and energy) m/m against its +0.3% consensus was not on the page I could read.

Reaction (Alpaca IEX prints; Webull is not connected): SPY 760.10 (+0.39%) before the print, 762.53 (+0.71%) at 08:33; QQQ +0.58%, IWM +0.43%, MU from -0.7% to +0.7%, NVDA 170.04 (+2.3%). A gap of about +0.7% opens SPY at Thursday's high (763.04, reached 11:23 before fading to 757.12).

p_up 0.53: the news is in the gap (OVERNIGHT.md: the gap barely predicts open to close); for it, the week's momentum (S&P +2.9%, Nasdaq +3.2%), breadth this morning (IWM, XLF +0.5%, XLE +0.5% up with the index) and VIX 18.3 (-2.3%); against it, a firm core that leaves the 12-09 hike in place, the 10Y at 5.13% (+2bp before the print, the cycle high), Bowman 10:50 and Daly 12:00, and a Friday after a +2.9% week with monthly expiry next week.

Rates and oil: CME FedWatch before the print (CNBC): 87% for a 25bp hike on 12-09 and 13% for 50bp, after Tuesday's hot CPI (+0.4% / core +0.3%); 2Y about 4.85%; dollar index at an 18-month high (Saxo). WTI above $88 and Brent above $96 after Trump's 'We don't need a deal with Iran' (USO +3.3% Thursday, -0.5% pre-market).
Thursday: SPY -0.35% close to close but +0.42% open to close (753.93 -> 757.12); NVDA opened -13% on Huang's resignation and closed -4.3% (+10% from its open); SMH -1.0%, IWM -1.6%, TLT -1.5%.

Overnight: Nikkei about +1%, Kospi -0.7% (SK Hynix -2%), Hang Seng -1%; STOXX 600 -0.2% from Thursday's record, chip names lower (Siltronic, Aixtron); Richemont -7%. Cerebras +17% pre-market (raised its 2026 revenue forecast, names Microsoft as a customer); Cisco -3% after a beat and a raised year (first day after its report); Applied Materials -0.8% after a beat.
Drop lights at Thursday's close (python -m zoh.research.drops --today): breadth and rates lit, stretched not lit. Both mark nothing about direction (DROPS.md); no change to p_up.

Pre-market down gaps of 2% or more in the rebound_scanner universe (08:17 consolidated tape): AMD -2.7% (569.70; no news of its own, giving back Thursday's +5.9%), COIN -2.6% (bitcoin under $69K, Korea's NPS cut its stake), AVGO -2.3% (Rothschild & Co Redburn to Neutral, target $398). HOOD -1.8% is under the line.

Dossiers: AMD's down gaps of 2% or more continued only 42% of the time (it tends to bounce), which is the scanner's trade today, not a sniper: there is no AMD news this morning. META is flat (+0.2%) with nothing of its own.

Earnings window: NVDA reports Tuesday 11-17 (two sessions away: allowed today, not picked). Next week's retailers (WMT, HD, TGT, LOW) are not in config/earnings.json and the Webull calendar cannot be read, so none of them is a sniper today (Wells Fargo raised its WMT target to $135).

sniper.catalyst: Own news from the last day: Bloomberg (carried by Reuters, Benzinga 16:31 Thursday and 24/7 Wall St. this morning) reports the Tesla-SpaceX merger talks are advancing, with special board committees negotiating structure and share-exchange terms and an announcement possible around Tesla's 12-03 shareholder meeting. It broke Thursday afternoon (TSLA +1.7% on the day, +0.6% after hours) and the gap is small: 400.80 (+0.8%) at 08:17, 404.02 (+1.65%) at 08:34 after the PPI. Against it: five gains in a row and +16% on the week, the best run since September 2025, so part of it is priced; no terms and no company statement; GLJ repeats its Sell. Not in a report window. Same-day expiry (Friday). Shadow only (catalyst_open carries no real stake since 11-09; the hero shadow takes the full-ledger sample).
sniper.wrong_if: TSLA is below its open at 10:00, or a report before then that the talks have stalled or slipped into 2027.

opportunities.why: Sniper (see sniper): merger talks with SpaceX advancing per Bloomberg, announcement possible around 12-03; gap +0.8% to +1.65%; five up days and +16% on the week argue part is priced. Confidence 0.25.

zh.summary: 08:30 的生产者价格（PPI）比预期低一点：环比 +0.3%（预期 +0.4%，上月 +1.3%），同比 6.5%（预期 6.6%）。标普 ETF 三分钟内从 +0.4% 拉到 +0.7%（762.5，正好到昨天的高点）。但去掉食品、能源和贸易后的核心还是 +0.5%，不算软，12 月加息基本还在（公布前定价 87% 加 25 个基点、13% 加 50 个基点），10 年期利率 5.13%。芯片分化：英伟达 +2.3%（辞职后第二天反弹），AMD -2.7%、博通 -2.3%（被下调评级）。微软宕机进入第二天（-1.2%）。油价回到 88 美元上方（特朗普说「不需要和伊朗达成协议」）。
zh.spy: 不做。收在开盘价上方的概率 53%：好消息已经在高开里了（开盘就在昨天的高点、这周已涨 2.9%），核心通胀不软、利率在高位、今天还有两位美联储官员讲话；但市场宽度不错（小盘股、银行、能源都跟涨），所以略偏多、不够下注。
zh.sniper: 特斯拉看涨（信心 0.25，只记影子）：彭博报道特斯拉和 SpaceX 的合并谈判在推进，双方董事会的特别委员会在谈结构和换股条件，最快 12 月 3 日股东大会前后宣布。消息是昨天下午出的，盘前只高开 0.8% 到 1.65%。风险：已经连涨五天、一周涨 16%，一部分已经在价格里；公司没有正式表态。10:00 如果跌回开盘价下方就算错。今天没有大盘股被上调评级。
zh.rotation: 升温：整条 AI 硬件链从 11-05 的低点五天反弹了 12% 到 27%（CPU、光模块、存储、硬盘、电力），但都还在 20 日线和 100 日线下方，是下跌趋势里的反弹；工业一周 +7%；医疗、消费、金融是这个月的领涨、这周安静。降温：英伟达（一周 -8.5%、一月 -25%，周二财报）；互联网（微软最弱）；博通涨了 25% 后今早被下调；小盘股和长债昨天各跌 1.5%。今天没有主题处于「转向」状态。
